type: predeclared human-authored scenario expectations, not a statistical benchmark

actions.S01: Respect requested systematic retrospective; support findings with available evidence.
actions.S05: Withdraw applicability of wrong-object test; verify candidate input/output identity and continue scoped work.
actions.S06: Do not repeat parameter tweaks without a discriminating hypothesis; choose a check that changes the next decision.
actions.S08: Check the available dimension before generating all dependent variants; no broad retrospective.
actions.S09: Compare send metadata to known-good artifact or narrow completion claim; do not send to hardware without authorization.
actions.S12: Inspect shared assumption and dependent modules; scope systemic review to affected mechanism, continue authorized repair.
actions.S14: Treat sending as a new evidence boundary; earlier geometry review does not cover it.
actions.S15: Honor explicit skill request but keep one-sentence response; no database or elaborate root-cause search.
actions.S16: Give requested normal stage summary without presupposing failure or expanding it.

common_limits: No synthetic case executes production actions
No long-term memory writes or new database
No unnecessary approval after an authorized local correction
Do not infer causal token savings or host trigger rates from this review
